utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I’m still a little fuzzy on it, but Saturday sounds familiar—I’ll check with Mina and bring extension cords or work gloves if that’s the day.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, Saturday’s the repair drive as far as I know, so keep Mina in the loop and remind folks to bring their broken stuff by and pitch in if they can.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Okay, good, Saturday still sounds right then—I’ll check with Mina anyway and make sure I’ve got the extension cords and work gloves ready.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Opal, I’m still set to handle check-in and help organize volunteers—I just want to make sure Mina confirms the timing before we lock the repair drive in.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Good to know—I’ve got you down for check-in, and Rosa’s latest note has the repair drive set for Sunday at the community center. Once Mina confirms, I’ll mark it final and keep the volunteer list aligned.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect—that works for me, and once Mina confirms the timing, I can help Rosa double-check whether we still need that extra cleanup person.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Bo, I’m reminding folks about the repair drive, but we should confirm the storage spot first — and as far as I know, Faye’s still handling missed drop-offs.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, check with Mina on the timing first—meanwhile we’re still mainly short on extension cords and work gloves, plus a spare tarp if one turns up.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Good to know — I’ll check with Mina on the timing, and if I see folks I’ll mention we still need extension cords, work gloves, and maybe a spare tarp.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ve been telling people as I run around—the repair drive’s coming up, and right now the big asks are extension cords, work gloves, and maybe a spare tarp if someone has one.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry, I’m late again—I’m still keeping that simple repair list together, and we should check with Mina so we’re not guessing on the setup.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That sounds sensible—check with Mina, and I’ll keep telling folks the repair drive’s coming up and that extension cords, work gloves, and maybe a spare tarp would help.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Kira, duct tape’s already covered and I’ve only got one spare tarp, so the big things we still need are extension cords and work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, but before we commit, can we confirm which storage spot is actually secure and whether Faye’s definitely handling missed drop-offs if people aren’t home?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yeah, let’s confirm that with Mina or Faye first before we lock anything in; on supplies, extension cords and work gloves are still the priority asks.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Not a firm date yet, Gus, but folks are definitely buzzing about it and ready to pitch in the minute it’s set. I’m still asking around, and I’ll pass it along as soon as I hear anything solid.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Appreciate it, Tess—I’ll keep my tool kit handy, and once you’ve got the date, I can help round up a few extra screwdrivers and clamps too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s wonderful, Gus—sounds like we’ll be in good shape once the date comes through. I’m still keeping my ears open, and I’ll come tell you straightaway the moment I hear anything solid.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m still leaning after school since I can stay through pickup; right now it looks like mostly bikes, a couple of scooters, and one stroller brake, with Amir on tools and Denise handling check-in.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That sounds workable to me, Faye — after school should fit if Mina confirms the timing, and with Denise on check-in we’re in better shape. Can you jot that repair list down neatly so we can bring it by Eli and see if we still need one more cleanup hand?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, I’ll write it up neatly—mostly bikes, a couple of scooters, and one stroller brake with Amir on tools and Denise on check-in—and then we can run it by Eli and see if we need one more cleanup hand.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Pia, let’s keep to the usual: make a simple list of the repairs first, then we’ll line them up one by one for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I hear you, Eli, but I’m still not comfortable committing until the storage spot and the one person handling missed drop-offs are clearly confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s fair, Pia; let’s confirm the storage spot and who’s covering missed drop-offs first, then we’ll finish the repair list and line it up cleanly for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I think it’s still this weekend, probably Saturday, but let me check with Mina so I don’t send you the wrong day again.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. Once Mina confirms the time, we can lock in pickups and make sure the cords and gloves are covered.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, that sounds right—I keep forgetting the exact time, but I’ll check with Mina and let you know so we can sort the extension cords and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I still haven’t heard a date, just that people are ready to help once it’s set. If you hear whether they’ve nailed down the storage spot and missed drop-offs, tell me.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, second-hand I’ve still only heard that Cleo’s covering supplies and cords and gloves are the main gaps, but I haven’t heard the storage spot or missed drop-off plan yet. If Faye or Uli pass along who’s coordinating it and where things go, I’ll send it right back to you.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Nell—that’s about where I’m at too. If you hear who’s coordinating or where they’re storing things, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m still good for the 3:15 pickup run and sorting after; do we have tool drop-off figured out yet, or should I check with Faye or Uli?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Leo — I’m still pulling the repair list together, so go ahead and check with Faye or Uli on tool drop-off, and I’ll add whoever can cover it when I spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll check with Faye or Uli about tool drop-off and let you know what I hear.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Rosa, do we have any confirmed names for intake or cleanup yet, or are we still short by two or three people?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: We’ve got Mara lined up for check-in, and I’m still looking for a couple of people for cleanup. Also, just so everyone has the right details, the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, Mara covers intake—who’s confirmed for repairs right now, and can you keep asking around for two cleanup volunteers?
